rules.deps: top-level imports (ast, absolute only) in the folder's .py files, minus stdlib and minus any module name defined as a .py file or package anywhere in the repo, so the list mixes third-party packages with modules imported but not present in this tree (e.g. a cross-repo source file); 'stdlib' when none; an import inside try/except is still counted
rules.claim_table: 'yes' if a file whose name starts with CLAIM (CLAIM_TABLE, CLAIMS) is anywhere in the folder, else 'no'; 'void' is not assigned by the script (its meaning is the owner's)
rules.refutation_protocol: 'yes' if the token REFUTATION_PROTOCOL occurs in a .md/.py/.json file of the folder, else 'no' (a mention, not a check that the protocol is followed)
rules.self_exclusion: the folder holding this draft (blind-reader-void12/studies/drafts/) is not scanned: it names the tokens it counts, so scanning it would count itself
rules.selftest: 'yes' if the string --selftest occurs in a .py file of the folder, else 'no' (a mention; refusals of --selftest also count; nothing is run)
